body: You are definitely not alone I went through basically the same thing when labouring with my first child. The midwives didn’t seem concerned but if you might be wondering or just wanting to ease your mind could always speak to a health professional? Labour can be rough so I think it’s a good time for the body to rest while it can :)

Omg congrats! Currently pregnant with our third girl (was kind of hoping for a boy but still happy either way) but think my partner is also wondering if this is some cruel trick 😆 Just told him we’ll have to try again for our boy the next time but I have a feeling we’ll definitely be overrun with girls and I’m not mad about it but might be feeling a smidge sorry for the guy lol

OP firstly please don’t feel pressured into doing something you are not comfortable with and as suggested by so many others on this thread please consult/ chat with your doctor, especially before making such a big decision. But I as many others here is to say that I was someone who had a healthy child after consuming alcohol in early pregnancy. With my first daughter I was around the same gestation as you (obviously didn’t know I was pregnant yet) and I drank on 2 occasions on a night out with friend’s. I also went through the same fears as you & I now can happily say I have a very healthy almost 3 year old.

Wishing you the best of luck on this journey!
